verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitbucket extends through specific integrations: a Snyk security-scan integration installed from the Security tab with other providers connectable, third-party code reports in PRs, connections to Jenkins and Bamboo, and access to the latest AI models via Rovo. None of this is described as a marketplace or catalog of third-party apps, actions, or models. missing for 10: an evidenced app marketplace, a catalog of reusable pipeline actions, a selectable third-party AI model catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
